name: ingenuity
$comment: NASA's Ingenuity Mars Helicopter: a demonstration flight (take off, 3 m hover, 5 m east, turn, land). Generated by design/build_model.py; see the README.

annotations.text: **Airframe (3D multibond).** World -> Free3D (6 DOF, quaternion pose) -> RigidBody3D (mass, apparent roll/pitch inertia, Mars gravity). Everything that acts on the airframe is bonded to the body's 1-junction: the rotors (Rotor3D), the hub wrenches and the drag wrench through fixed mounts at the hub and fuselage centre, and the four landing-gear contacts through mounts at the feet.

**Propulsion (bond graph, one chain per rotor).** Electrical 1-junction: the winding voltage (MSe, set by the rotor-speed governor), the winding and drive losses (R), a current detector (Df) and the motor gyrator (GY, k_t). Shaft 1-junction at the rotor speed relative to the airframe: the motor, the rotor's axial momentum (Rotor3D, bonded to the airframe body: its torque reaction and gyroscopic moment act on the airframe) and the blade-element/momentum aerodynamics (RotorBEMT, a nonlinear R). The thrust, H-force and hub moments act on the airframe at the hub (Hub mount + HubWrench). The lower rotor sees the upper rotor's uniform inflow (AeroU.v0 -> AeroL.vext).

**Flight software.** FlightPlan (waypoint moves, climb and descent at 1 m/s) -> FlightControl (500 Hz: heave and yaw by symmetric and antisymmetric collective, inner roll/pitch on cyclic, outer horizontal position; Grip et al. 2018). Nav reads the pose: the navigation estimate is taken as perfect.

options.text: Take off, climb to the hover altitude, fly east, turn and land. Change the **air density**, the **rotor speed** or the **wind** and press **Run** (the 30 s flight takes a minute or two).
